progression.stopsAfter: Named hydra budding mechanism, a haploid-to-diploid animal set model, contextual external/internal fusion, bird development contrast and a supplied separation prediction. No detailed meiosis, hormones, reproductive anatomy, pregnancy or plant/microbe mechanisms.

Hydra growth and detachment form offspring without fusion.
